steps.name: the public role reads books and locales, as the project's does
register
steps.graphql: mutation { register(input: { username: "ann", email: "Ann@Example.test", password: "secret1" }) { jwt user { username email confirmed blocked role { name type } } } }

steps.name: register taken
steps.graphql: mutation { register(input: { username: "ann", email: "ann@example.test", password: "secret1" }) { jwt } }

steps.name: register invalid email
steps.graphql: mutation { register(input: { username: "ann2", email: "nope", password: "secret1" }) { jwt } }

steps.name: login by email
steps.graphql: mutation Login($input: UsersPermissionsLoginInput!) { login(input: $input) { jwt user { username email } } }

steps.name: me
steps.graphql: { me { username email confirmed blocked role { name description type } } }

steps.name: me with a token that does not verify
change password
steps.graphql: mutation { changePassword(currentPassword: "secret1", password: "secret2", passwordConfirmation: "secret2") { jwt user { username } } }

steps.name: reset password with a wrong code
reset password
steps.graphql: mutation { resetPassword(code: "$code", password: "secret3", passwordConfirmation: "secret3") { jwt user { username } } }

steps.name: login with the new password
steps.graphql: mutation { login(input: { identifier: "ann", password: "secret3" }) { user { username } } }

steps.name: confirm an email with a wrong code
users with their role, as a user
create a user without the grant
steps.graphql: mutation { createUsersPermissionsUser(data: { username: "eve", email: "eve@example.test", password: "secret1" }) { data { username } } }

steps.name: list users
steps.graphql: { usersPermissionsUsers(sort: "username") { username email confirmed blocked role { name } } }

steps.name: users by filter, with a page
steps.graphql: { usersPermissionsUsers_connection(filters: { username: { startsWith: "a" } }) { nodes { username } pageInfo { total page pageSize pageCount } } }

steps.name: a role's users
steps.graphql: { usersPermissionsRoles(filters: { type: { eq: "authenticated" } }) { name users { username } users_connection { nodes { username } } } }

steps.name: create a user
steps.graphql: mutation { createUsersPermissionsUser(data: { username: "bob", email: "bob@example.test", password: "secret1", role: "$authenticated" }) { data { username email confirmed blocked role { name } } } }

steps.name: create a user that is taken
steps.graphql: mutation { createUsersPermissionsUser(data: { username: "bob", email: "bob2@example.test", password: "secret1", role: "$authenticated" }) { data { username } } }

steps.name: update a user
steps.graphql: mutation { updateUsersPermissionsUser(id: "$bob", data: { username: "robert", blocked: true }) { data { username blocked } } }

steps.name: update a user that is not there
steps.graphql: mutation { updateUsersPermissionsUser(id: "9999", data: { username: "ghost" }) { data { username } } }

steps.name: the updated user
steps.graphql: { usersPermissionsUsers(filters: { username: { eq: "robert" } }) { documentId username blocked } }

steps.name: a user that is not there
locales as a connection
steps.graphql: { i18NLocales_connection(filters: { code: { eq: "fr" } }) { nodes { name code } pageInfo { total } } }

steps.name: locales as a connection, with the grant
steps.graphql: { i18NLocales_connection(filters: { code: { eq: "fr" } }) { nodes { name code } pageInfo { total } } }

steps.name: files
steps.graphql: { uploadFiles { name caption ext mime url provider } }

steps.name: files as a connection
steps.graphql: { uploadFiles_connection(filters: { ext: { eq: ".txt" } }) { nodes { name } pageInfo { total } } }

steps.name: update a file's info
steps.graphql: mutation { updateUploadFile(id: "$fileId", info: { alternativeText: "A greeting", caption: "Hello" }) { name alternativeText caption } }
